messages:
Nina (CS Ops): quick alert — noticed a handful of onboarding accounts received the 'welcome-nudge' twice in 24h. happens after playbook handoff runs. saw 42 duplicates across 3 regions.
Arjun (CRM): oh no. which playbook run id? could be a race when ownership flips during handoff.
Nina (CS Ops): run id: handoff-613579. looks like the handoff job triggers outbound actions before the ownership flag writes are fully committed.
Felix (Data): can we get the event timeline? i want to see order of writes for owner_id and playbook_trigger_ts.
Hannah (Enablement): double nudge is noisy. can we gate outbound actions on an owner-confirmed flag? lightweight fix = a 5-minute debounce on outbound events for newly handed-off accounts.
Arjun (CRM): agree. adding a small idempotency guard should fix it: skip outbound if last_playbook_sent_at >= now() - interval '5 minutes'.
Nina (CS Ops): prefer a safer rollout: sample 15% of affected handoffs, apply debounce and hold nudges, tag sampled accounts to let CS filter.
playbook-bot: created run id guard-handoff-613579  status: queued. (/playbooks/run guard-handoff-613579) :gear:
Felix (Data): ran a quick group-by: duplicates concentrated in eu-west and ap-south. hypothesis: cross-region replication lag plus parallel handoff workers.
Arjun (CRM): i'll add the idempotency check in mapping layer and gate it behind feature flag 'handoff.debounce'. pushing to staging. snippet: 
Arjun (CRM): ```sql
update playbook_actions set status='skipped'
where account_id in (select account_id from sampled_handoffs)
and last_playbook_sent_at >= now() - interval '5 minutes';
```
Hannah (Enablement): can the admin console expose the run-level toggle so CS leads can flip the debounce on/off for this run without ops?
Arjun (CRM): yes — added admin path admin.playbooks.debounce_run=guard-handoff-613579. also attaching runbook: 
Arjun (CRM): ```yaml
run_id: guard-handoff-613579
sample_rate: 0.15
actions:
  - debounce_outbound: 5m
  - hold_nudges: true
  - add_tags: [handoff:guarded, cs:triage-needed]
  - notify: cs-owners
```
Nina (CS Ops): perfect. Felix, once you confirm eu-west replication skew, we'll expand sample to 40% and keep hold for 24h.
Felix (Data): replication lag confirmed ~12-18s in eu-west under peak. ap-south sometimes hits 30s. increasing debounce to 60s should be safe and reduce false holds.
playbook-bot: guard-handoff-613579 moved to in-progress  status: active. :white_check_mark:
Hannah (Enablement): i'll draft a single-sentence owner note: "Heads-up: your handoff completed; we'll wait 60s before reaching out to avoid duplicate messages."
Nina (CS Ops): thanks all. next: Arjun deploys flag to prod behind feature flag, Felix monitors duplicate rate metric, Hannah prepares owner-facing line, and i'll coordinate sampled triage tomorrow 09:30 PT. will update thread when sample review finishes.
